confirmed_findings_and_changes: Public list/detail GET representative amounts lack sufficient original-condition evidence. They are never used as verified customer prices.

Shared module validates complete catalog identities and pagination, selects explicit RENTAL vehicles, validates available default trim and calls existing selection_v1 instant quote for RENTAL, 60 months, 10000 km/year, zero advance, zero guarantee, no selected options or colors.

Only unchanged server monthly_payment with strict original source evidence or the existing narrowly scoped selection_terms_estimate_v1 evidence is displayed. Contradictory, unavailable or missing proof gives no invented amount.

Direct condition evidence requires one BASE point, CHAZM_IMPORTED, CONDITION_DIRECT, exact source path and actual term/mileage/advance. Request echoes alone are insufficient. Other already supported anchor methods retain their existing contract.

Full rental identities remain available when prices are unknown. Public list price lookups are capped at 12 quote requests, concurrency 2, timeout 12 seconds per request; parent cancellation prevents late follow-up POSTs.

Static fallback prices, arbitrary time-dependent margins, unsubstantiated 12-hour/monthly-saving claims and browser option/IRR monthly recomputation were removed from active promotional paths. Existing server pricing formulas are unchanged.
Public estimated prices carry accurate estimate/condition information. Unrecorded guarantee evidence is not presented as independently proven zero guarantee.

New inquiry product is RENTAL only; nonzero guarantee is rejected. Advance percentage choices are requested consultation conditions, not guaranteed displayed monthly amounts. Existing historical records and the old cache key are retained.

Public Node gateway uses the same evidence boundary. Non-default values for historically supported price inputs (term, deposit_pct, mileage_limit) and explicitly checked additional condition keys fail before upstream calls. Arbitrary unknown query keys are not claimed to be rejected. Legacy manual/spreadsheet IDs cannot return invented public prices.
Original layout, image assets, referral and inquiry handoff remain; source-image URLs are normalized to HTTPS API asset origin without URL credentials.
